relationships.subject: P2X4
relationships.evidence_quote: The P2X4 receptor is an ATP-gated ion channel, and its activation can induce the release of BDNF from microglia.

relationships.subject: BDNF
relationships.evidence_quote: BDNF released from activated microglia can alter the expression and function of potassium-chloride cotransporter 2 (KCC2, K+-Cl- cotransporter 2) in dorsal horn neurons through activation of TrkB signaling.

relationships.subject: KCC2
relationships.evidence_quote: Downregulation of KCC2 disrupts chloride homeostasis and weakens inhibitory neurotransmission mediated by γ-aminobutyric acid (GABA) and glycine (37, 49, 50).

relationships.subject: CX3CL1
relationships.evidence_quote: Activation of this pathway promotes microglial proliferation and the production of pro-inflammatory cytokines, including tumor necrosis factor-α (TNF-α) and interleukin-1β (IL-1β) (42).

key_findings: Review of spinal microglia in visceral hypersensitivity, with ATP/P2X4, CX3CL1 and CSF1 driving microglial release of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta and BDNF.
BDNF-TrkB-KCC2 axis proposed as key pathway of microglia-mediated disinhibition; includes a COMSOL diffusion model.
